does.method: ProcessSavegameLoaded (load repair of the end-of-day state)
does.text: In the update, after a savegame load has finished (a removal of eoc::gamestate::SavegameLoadComponent is seen), the system looks at the entity holding eoc::rest::LongRestState. When that state's first byte is 0, 1 or 2 it walks the entities holding eoc::camp::EndTheDayStateComponent; for each whose own state byte is 0 it takes that entity's end-of-day state through a helper (bg3_dx11.exe+0x2BF78D0, not read; Review 2026-11-14 (Opus): earlier read as building a new state, which the code does not show), marks it changed, sets its first byte to 2 and adds esv::camp::EndTheDayLoadForceChangeStateEventOneFrameComponent to the entity. Read as (a reading, not shown by the code): a game loaded in the middle of a long rest pushes the end-of-day state forward and announces it. The meaning of the byte values is not known. Review 2026-11-14 (Opus, systems I): in EoCServer.dll this is the named method ProcessSavegameLoaded; it logs 'Adjusting saved state to be InCamp', so state 2 is called InCamp; the LongRestState values 0-2 are Created, Validation and RestTypeRequest by eoc::rest::LongRestStateToString (the systems-I author's reading of the test +0x7419C0; the reviewer re-read the guard, not the enum).
does.evidence: bg3_dx11.exe+0x2BF5280 (called from +0x2BF4F20, the system update), read in full around the add call at its tail. Query spec names read from the type-name initialisers at +0x3D30F0 (removed SavegameLoadComponent), +0x3DE3A0 (LongRestState) and +0x2CE770 (EndTheDayStateComponent); the add helper is +0x2BF73B0 (frame-storage alloc, global +0x60D1818). The 'savegame load finished' guard is a query-has-entities test over two query slots at the top of the function, taken from the query spec names, not traced further. EoCServer.dll+0x9D0460 esv::camp::EndTheDaySystem::ProcessSavegameLoaded: two removed-queries (DAT_182205230, DAT_1821f4d60) tested with HasAny, LongRestState query DAT_18221bbe4 and test +0x7419C0, EndTheDayStateComponent query DAT_18221bcb8, byte == 0 test, store of 2, add helper +0x9C7C20 = frame storage of DAT_18221be40 = EndTheDayLoadForceChangeStateEventOneFrameComponent.
does.check: not checkable live with the verbs as built: the claim needs a savegame loaded in the middle of a long rest, and a recipe starts from the copy's checkpoint; the tag would be {appears: esv::camp::EndTheDayLoadForceChangeStateEventOneFrameComponent} in a proposed recipe camp_load_during_long_rest (start the rest, save, load) if a watch outlives a load; the state byte set to 2 is on eoc::camp::EndTheDayStateComponent, which has no layout (not expressible yet)

does.text: The method is a state machine on the end-of-day entity's eoc::camp::EndTheDayStateComponent byte. In state 0, when a helper at the top (bg3_dx11.exe+0x2BF5F40, not read) gives a valid entity (read as the initiator), it moves the state to 1 and adds esv::camp::ReadyCheckRequestOneFrameComponent to the end-of-day entity, its event id from a global FixedString and its text one of two handles: h566a32b1g1e58g4df0g9368g5b7a37f2d40d ('not enough camp supplies', half restore) when a first count is lower than a second, otherwise h2908c522gaea2g457ag9d0fg05ab7a55961b ('enough camp supplies'). Reading, not shown: the counts are the supplies held and the supplies a full rest needs. This is the 'End the day?' box.
does.evidence: bg3_dx11.exe+0x2BF61B0 esv::camp::EndTheDaySystem::FinalizeEndTheDayState (toolkit match by strings): the state-0 branch, the call to the ReadyCheckRequest adder bg3_dx11.exe+0x2BF7BC0 and the two handles chosen around it (resolved with gatekit data text). That FUN_142b5e270 writes the new state is read from its pattern (a value 0-4 by pointer, then a commit helper), not traced. EoCServer.dll+0x9CB4C0 (named): the state-0 branch logs 'EndTheDay was requested and Available'; ReadyCheckRequest adder +0x9C8200 (DAT_1821f7938), Result adder +0x9C7E10 (DAT_18222f834), log 'Creating Result event' before it.
does.check_note: appears: yes. Which text (equals on TranslatedString) is not checkable live: equals reads the field when the recipe's steps are over (GK.Probe.FieldValues), and a one-frame component is gone by then; appears is watched every tick, equals is not, and whether equals compares a TranslatedString with a handle string is not said. The state 0 -> 1 is not expressible yet: eoc::camp::EndTheDayStateComponent has no layout.

does.text: In state 1, when frame byte 9 is set (read as: the ready check's result arrived), the state goes to 2 with result code 3 if frame byte 8 is set, and back to 0 with result code 2 if not. Reading, not shown: byte 8 is 'accepted', since only that path goes on with the rest.
